# Approved control preset assets

Ported from the user-approved local study at `/Users/jasminepoon/src/astra-button-prototype/astra-button-prototype`, preset `b5XkwJTfHs`: Radix Vega, zinc/cyan, default radius, Public Sans body and Roboto Slab headings.

`controls.css` preserves the study's generated dark semantic color tokens and radius. The vanilla `control-ui.js` applies shared primary, outline, ghost, selected, disabled and busy variants to static and generated controls. The app keeps its original architecture and real quote/bridge/engine state.

The two Latin variable WOFF2 files come from the installed Fontsource packages. Their licenses are included alongside them. `control-icons.js` contains only the regular-weight SVG markup for eighteen Phosphor icons, rendered from the installed package; its MIT license is included. No React runtime, sample timers, sample paths or prototype state machine is used in the app.
